verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a single-command CLI deploy from the working directory (`netlify deploy --allow-anonymous`), with no login required to start, so the deploy half of the story is directly supported. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project; project creation is described only via an AI agent, a Git repository, or drag and drop. missing for 10: CLI scaffolding/template-init in the same command, evidence that scaffold and deploy happen together in one step, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Deploy directly from your working directory. No login required to start.
Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
